mapper.select: select id, title, artist, album, cover_url, duration_sec, lyric, tags from music order by created_time desc limit 10
select * from music where tags like concat('%', #{tag}, '%') order by created_time desc
select id, title, artist, album, cover_url, duration_sec from music where title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or artist like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') order by created_time desc
select m.id, m.title, m.artist, m.album, m.cover_url, m.duration_sec from history h join music m on h.music_id = m.id where h.user_id = #{userId} order by h.play_time desc limit 20
